what: A release step had no `--help`, and an externally built run's own identity was unrecoverable. A release command failed outright on `--help`, and, separately, a run built outside the normal flow left no way to name which run had produced a given branch, costing a manual source read to piece it back together.
rule: Every command answers `--help`, and every result names the run (or the branch) that produced it.
fix: Enforcement: `--help`/`-h` now prints usage and exits cleanly before any other flag is parsed, and every release result carries its own run or branch identifier. Regression coverage is in `tests/ship-125.test.mjs` and `tests/wire-125.test.mjs`.
